```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download
    - name: Run linter
      run: golangci-lint run --fix

  build-and-test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download
    - name: Format code
      run: go fmt ./...
    - name: Build project
      run: go build ./...
    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        file: coverage.out
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-go
        fail_ci_if_error: true
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a CI pipeline for the `Colin-XKL/FeedCraft` repository. It includes two jobs:

1. **Lint**: This job runs `golangci-lint` to check and fix linting issues in the codebase. It is configured to run before the `build-and-test` job.

2. **Build-and-Test**: This job runs after the `lint` job has completed successfully. It formats the code using `gofmt`, builds the project, and runs the tests. If all steps pass, it uploads the test coverage report to Codecov.

The workflow is triggered on both pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch. It ensures that linting issues are fixed automatically and that the build and tests pass before allowing changes to be merged into the `main` branch.
